Category index/listing archetype and navigation density.
Primary account creation path, consent disclosure, autofill and error handling.
Primary watch-detail journey from a current homepage card; metadata succeeded but one navigation returned 503.

findings.summary: Fixed dark theme ignores the user’s colour-scheme preference
findings.evidence: The dark-emulated screenshot is visually identical to the default dark UI, but the document probe reports computed color-scheme: normal rather than declaring supported schemes.
findings.suggestedFix: Declare color-scheme at document level and use preference-aware tokens with light-dark() or prefers-color-scheme.

findings.summary: Infinite shimmer continues under reduced-motion
findings.evidence: The reduced-motion probe found eight running shimmer animations with 2,000 ms duration and infinite iterations, and found zero prefers-reduced-motion rules.
findings.suggestedFix: Disable non-essential shimmer and preview motion under prefers-reduced-motion: reduce.

findings.summary: Route and state changes have no transition treatment
findings.evidence: The modern CSS probe found zero view-transition rules on a multi-route interactive site, while the browser API is available. Navigation and consent state swap abruptly.
findings.suggestedFix: Use same-document or cross-document View Transitions for meaningful route/state changes, with reduced-motion handling.

findings.summary: Cookie consent obscures the primary content and lacks dialog semantics
findings.evidence: First-load screenshots on home, categories and 404 show a large centered consent layer obscuring the page. DOM probes found no dialog, popover, or role=dialog despite modal presentation.
findings.suggestedFix: Use a semantic dialog with focus management and a compact, non-obscuring consent design; retain equal Accept and Reject actions.

findings.summary: Desktop-width layout overflows a 360 px viewport
findings.evidence: The 360x800 layout capture measured scrollWidth 1024 px against a 360 px visual viewport, 664 px horizontal overflow; the screenshot clips the desktop sidebar and content.
findings.suggestedFix: Replace fixed desktop widths with intrinsic/fluid layout, and select a genuinely mobile template from viewport capabilities rather than a brittle signal.

findings.summary: Components do not adapt at container level
findings.evidence: The modern CSS probe found zero container-query rules, while the listing/sidebar composition is reused across widths and visibly clips at 360 px.
findings.suggestedFix: Introduce container-type on reusable regions and @container rules for card grids, nav and sidebars.

findings.summary: Primary watch journey intermittently fails with a raw 503
findings.evidence: Following a current home-page video URL produced an unstyled nginx “503 Service Temporarily Unavailable” screenshot. A later metadata probe succeeded, showing an intermittent backend/runtime failure rather than a dead link.
findings.suggestedFix: Harden the detail route and CDN/origin path, then render a branded retry state instead of the raw server error.

findings.summary: Mobile lab LCP misses the good threshold
findings.evidence: Lighthouse measured LCP 3.2 s on mobile (performance 0.89), while the direct trace measured 1.52 s in a separate desktop-like run; the slower representative condition exceeds the 2.5 s good threshold.
findings.suggestedFix: Prioritise the LCP asset and reduce critical script/style work, then verify on mobile throttling.

findings.summary: The homepage ships a heavy script and third-party dependency graph
findings.evidence: HAR recorded 141 requests and 1.79 MB transferred; 61 scripts account for 988 KB, the largest bundle is 400 KB, and 113 requests/1.60 MB are cross-origin.
findings.suggestedFix: Split and conditionally load non-critical bundles, defer Google sign-in until needed, and set a request/third-party budget.

findings.summary: Interactive names, roles and list semantics are broken
findings.evidence: Lighthouse found an unnamed button, label/content name mismatches on video links, an li with role=button, and non-li direct children inside a ul; accessibility score was 0.75.
findings.suggestedFix: Use native links/buttons with matching accessible names and valid list structure; remove redundant conflicting roles.

findings.summary: Important text fails minimum contrast
findings.evidence: Lighthouse measured the age-verification banner at 2.15:1 and 1.75:1, video-view text at 3.29:1, and also found a link distinguishable only by near-identical colour.
findings.suggestedFix: Raise foreground/background contrast to WCAG AA and add a non-colour link affordance.

findings.summary: Zoom is disabled and some touch targets are undersized
findings.evidence: Lighthouse found user-scalable=no in the effective mobile viewport and 20 px-high/overlapping targets, failing its meta-viewport and target-size audits.
findings.suggestedFix: Remove user-scalable=no, permit unrestricted zoom, and provide at least 24x24 CSS px targets with spacing (prefer 44x44).

findings.summary: Image delivery wastes bytes and risks instability
findings.evidence: The image audit found 29/36 images without width and height, 13 oversized images, 8 below-fold images not lazy-loaded, and 15 legacy-format detections.
findings.suggestedFix: Reserve dimensions, generate right-sized srcset candidates, lazy-load below-fold media and serve modern formats consistently.

findings.summary: Localized indexing signals are incomplete
findings.evidence: The public site exposes many locale subdomains, but the probe found zero hreflang links; /sitemap.xml returned an empty body. The canonical points to the xhamster.com alias, so crawlers lack a complete localized URL map on this host.
findings.suggestedFix: Publish a valid sitemap and reciprocal hreflang links for localized variants; keep canonical/host strategy internally consistent.

findings.summary: Video detail lacks structured VideoObject data
findings.evidence: The valid video-detail probe found comprehensive Open Graph/Twitter metadata but zero JSON-LD blocks for a rich video entity.
findings.suggestedFix: Add accurate schema.org VideoObject JSON-LD matching the visible title, thumbnail, duration and canonical URL.

findings.summary: Browser security policy and cookie flags are weak
findings.evidence: Headers show CSP limited to frame-ancestors, missing X-Content-Type-Options and Referrer-Policy, while four of five cookies lack Secure and several use SameSite=None.
findings.suggestedFix: Deploy an enforcing script/style CSP, nosniff and a privacy-preserving Referrer-Policy; mark HTTPS cookies Secure and use the narrowest SameSite value.

findings.summary: Third-party activity starts before a consent choice
findings.evidence: The initial HAR, captured while the cookie prompt was still present, includes Google Tag Manager and Google Identity; 113/141 requests and 1.60/1.79 MB were cross-origin.
findings.suggestedFix: Gate optional analytics/identity code behind consent or explicit sign-in intent and minimise cross-origin requests before choice.

findings.summary: Signup exposes federated/password options but no phishing-resistant path
findings.evidence: The signup path offers Google, X and email/password. Probes found no WebAuthn/passkey affordance or navigator.credentials flow on the representative auth surface.
findings.suggestedFix: Offer passkey creation/sign-in alongside federated fallback and request credentials only from the explicit auth flow.

findings.summary: App-like service has a manifest but no active offline support
findings.evidence: A manifest is linked, but the loaded page had no controlling service worker. The video platform is app-like and its primary detail request also demonstrated a transient 503.
findings.suggestedFix: Register a narrowly scoped service worker and provide cached shell/offline/retry states for navigation and key metadata.

findings.summary: Localized variants are not backed by robust bidi/layout signals
findings.evidence: The page links dozens of language subdomains, but exposes no hreflang links and the CSS probe counted 371 physical left/right declarations versus 19 logical-property occurrences.
findings.suggestedFix: Publish lang/hreflang consistently and migrate reusable layout spacing/positioning to logical properties; verify RTL variants.

findings.summary: Empty signup submission provides no actionable error state
findings.evidence: After opening email signup and triggering submit with empty fields, the probe found no invalid elements, no role=alert messages and no visible actionable validation state.
findings.suggestedFix: Use required/input types, validate after interaction, set aria-invalid only when appropriate, and announce clear field-specific errors.

findings.summary: Signup disables email autofill
findings.evidence: The email signup probe reports autocomplete=off on both email controls; only the password field uses new-password.
findings.suggestedFix: Use type=email and autocomplete=email on the single email field, retain autocomplete=new-password, and remove duplicate hidden/text email controls from focus/AT.

Harden CSP, cookie flags and browser security headers
Gate optional Google/analytics code until consent or explicit auth intent
Repair accessible names, roles, list semantics and contrast
Make consent semantic and less obstructive
Reduce script/third-party weight and improve LCP
Fix image sizing, responsive delivery and lazy loading
Add humane signup validation and autofill tokens
Add passkeys and resilient offline/retry support
